title: Daylight Sensor
body:
"Outputs a number [0, 24), depending on current time of day"

The Daylight Sensor is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a signal of 0-23 (0 is equal to 24 in a 24hr clock) depending on the current in-game time.

The Daylight Sensors appearance is near identical to the Weather Sensor, with an eyeball as the main feature. The only differentiating part visually is the colour of the eye's iris.

Functionality

When placed, the Daylight Sensor outputs a value of 0 - 23 depending on the current in-game time, however, the Daylight Sensor does not show the minutes or seconds of in-game time, only the hours.

The Daylight Sensor allows the user interact with structures such as the Electronic Billboard or 14 Segment Display, using wires. When connected to these structures, the output number [0-9] will be shown on a singular display, and if two displays are connected correctly, the output number [0-23] will be displayed.

The Daylight Sensor is an output logic system only. It has no input connection.
